whoWeAre.title: ZARVE
whoWeAre.headline: Technology that makes complex businesses easier to control.
body: ZARVE Digital Solution connects operations, transactions, finance, ERP, data, and automation in one platform.

With ZARVE, companies can improve visibility, efficiency, control, and decision making through technology built for modern businesses on the move — vehicle rental, transportation, logistics, workshops, and corporations with operational fleets.
whoWeAre.vision: To become the digital infrastructure platform that powers the transformation of the mobility, transportation, rental, automotive, and enterprise industries in Indonesia.

challenge.title: Business grows.
challenge.description: The bigger the fleet, the more points that need to be controlled every day — and the easier it is to lose visibility.

story.title: Built from
body: ZARVE was born from a real need to unify mobility, after-sales, and finance businesses.

Our technology is built not just from theory, but from experience, process, and everyday operational challenges on the ground — one real ecosystem that became the foundation for ZARVE's technology development.
story.imageAlt: A fleet of vehicles that forms the basis of ZARVE's operations

ecosystem.title: One platform.
